name: unverified_0x452E25 unauthenticated uniswapV3SwapCallback
summary: The contract's uniswapV3SwapCallback() paid out the requested amount to msg.sender without verifying that the caller was a genuine Uniswap V3 pool, so a direct call with a fabricated delta and token address transferred 27.3 WETH out.
notes: The direct runtime containing the callback defect was installed by this top-level contract creation.
The exploit receipt records exactly 27.349 WETH leaving the victim and then being forwarded unchanged to the attacker EOA.
